common.text_input_rule: g=torch.Generator().manual_seed(seed); input_ids=torch.randint(3, config.vocab_size, (B, L), generator=g, dtype=int64); ids equal to config pad/eos/bos/decoder_start (int or list) -> 3; attention_mask=torch.ones(B, L, dtype=int64). No tokenizer, no BOS insertion, no truncation.
common.image_input_rule: g=torch.Generator().manual_seed(seed); pixel_values=torch.randn(B, 3, R, R, generator=g, dtype=float32).to(float16). No image processor (no resize/crop).
common.generation_rule: GenerationConfig.from_model_config(model.config) then do_sample=False, num_beams=1, use_cache=True, min_new_tokens=max_new_tokens=N, pad_token_id=config.pad_token_id or eos, no repetition penalty/sampling knobs from hub generation_config.json. decoder: output.shape[1]-L == N; T5: decoder starts from decoder_start_token_id only, output.shape[1]-1 == N (start token excluded)
common.inputs_device_rule: inputs kept on host CPU, moved with .to('cuda') inside every invocation
